pairs: Audet aliquis vestrum habens negotium adversus alterum,
How is it that anyone of you, having a dispute against another,
would dare to be judged before the iniquitous,
an nescitis quoniam sancti de hoc mundo judicabunt?
Or do you not know that the saints from this age shall judge it?
et si in vobis judicabitur mundus,
And if the world is to be judged by you,
indigni estis qui de minimis judicetis?
are you unworthy, then, to judge even the smallest matters?
Do you not know that we shall judge angels?
How much more the things of this age?
Therefore, if you have matters to judge concerning this age,
contemptibiles, qui sunt in ecclesia, illos constituite ad judicandum.
why not appoint those who are most contemptible in the Church to judge these things!
But I am speaking so as to shame you.
Sic non est inter vos sapiens quisquam,
Is there no one among you wise enough,
qui possit judicare inter fratrem suum?
so that he might be able to judge between his brothers?
Sed frater cum fratre judicio contendit:
Instead, brother contends against brother in court,
Jam quidem omnino delictum est in vobis,
Now there is certainly an offense among you, beyond everything else,
when you have court cases against one another.
Should you not accept injury instead?
Should you not endure being cheated instead?
But you are doing the injuring
An nescitis quia iniqui regnum Dei non possidebunt?
Do you not know that the iniquitous will not possess the kingdom of God?
Do not choose to wander astray.
nor males who sleep with males,
nor the rapacious shall possess the kingdom of God.
And some of you were like this.
sed justificati estis in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
all in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.
sed ego sub nullis redigar potestate.
but I will not be driven back by the authority of anyone.
and the stomach is for food.
Deus autem et hunc et has destruet:
But God shall destroy both the stomach and food.
And the body is not for fornication,
and the Lord is for the body.
God has raised up the Lord,
et nos suscitabit per virtutem suam.
and he will raise us up by his power.
Nescitis quoniam corpora vestra membra sunt Christi?
Do you not know that your bodies are a part of Christ?
should I take a part of Christ and make it a part of a harlot?
An nescitis quoniam qui adhæret meretrici, unum corpus efficitur?
And do you not know that whoever is joined to a harlot becomes one body?
Erunt enim (inquit) duo in carne una.
“For the two,” he said, “shall be as one flesh.”
Qui autem adhæret Domino, unus spiritus est.
But whoever is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
Omne peccatum, quodcumque fecerit homo, extra corpus est:
Every sin whatsoever that a man commits is outside of the body,
An nescitis quoniam membra vestra, templum sunt Spiritus Sancti,
Or do you not know that your bodies are the Temple of the Holy Spirit,
and that you are not your own?
For you have been bought at a great price.
et portate Deum in corpore vestro.
and carry God in your body.
